name: Phase 1 Launch Blocker Fixes
userOutcome: Users can save outcome reviews without forcing verdict selections, navigate from terminated-app notifications to outcomes, recover from store initialization failures, and have their data preserved when demo data is removed. Save failures do not silently abandon draft state.
entryPoints: Notification deep link from terminated state (MainTabView .task)
App launch with corrupted/missing store files (HindsightApp)
SettingsView demo removal with mixed real/demo data
All model save sites (OutcomeReviewView, NewDecisionWizard, SettingsView, DecisionDetailView, SampleData)
productionDataSource: Decision model with embedded Prediction entries; locally persisted Call schedule and notification receipts
errorBehavior: Store init failure: no crash, recovery screen with Retry/Export/Reset options; save failure: screen stays open, draft preserved, non-blocking retryable alert, no success haptic, no dismissal, no notification side-effects executed. Demo removal: only UUID-matched records deleted; title-matched orphans acceptable.
layoutScenarios: Recovery screen after store open failure
accessibilityRequirements: Recovery screen buttons labeled and routable
Alert messages announced on save failure
prohibitedBehavior: Do not preselect any verdict chip in outcome review.
Do not delete user records by title heuristic.
Do not crash on corrupted store; must offer recovery.
Do not execute notification side-effects after failed save.
Do not silently suppress save errors with try?.
acceptanceTests: testResolution_newCallHasNoPreselectedVerdict: new prediction seeds nil, renders unselected
testResolution_allowsOneTerminalChoice: ungraded prediction can be saved
testDemoCleanup_deletesOnlyExplicitDemoProvenance: real decision with demo-sample title survives removal
testStoreOpenFailureIsRecoverable: injected failing config shows recovery screen, no crash
testPersistence_failurePreservesDraft: wizard save failure keeps sheet open with draft
testPersistence_failureCancelsNoSideEffects: review save failure executes no success haptics/notifications
testColdLaunchDeepLink_tappedDecisionIDConsumedInTask: terminated-app notification tap routes to target detail
Full unit test suite: 59/59 green on iPhone 17 Pro simulator
